role.commercial_navigator.desc: I navigate a commercial or cargo vessel.
role.researcher.desc: I study ocean and weather data.
role.coastal_authority.desc: I coordinate safety for a district or station.
savedLocations.title: Saved places
ask.heading: Ask about conditions at sea
ask.subheading: Ask in plain English, Tamil, Hindi, or any Indian regional language. ORCA evaluates live ocean weather, maritime boundary standoff, depth contours, and fishing advisories with full citation provenance.
zones.title: Fishing zones
zones.lede: The INCOIS Potential Fishing Zone advisory for your sector, the nearest advised zone with a heading and distance, and how persistent it has been.
zones.nearestAdvisoryNeighbour: The nearest published advisory below is in a neighbouring sector.
zones.noZoneBody: INCOIS has published no PFZ node near this position. ORCA reports none rather than showing a stale one.
zones.apiError: Could not reach the ORCA API
zones.apiErrorBody: The zones service did not respond. Start the backend, then reload this page.
zones.loginForHomePort: log in to use your home port
watches.title: Watches
watches.lede: Standing alerts on a place you care about — Sentinel checks it on a schedule and tells you when conditions cross your thresholds.
watches.waveDefault: Wave height over 2.5 m within 10 km, in-app alerts.
watches.noWatchesBody: Add your home port above, or use Advanced to watch a specific point with your own thresholds.
watches.serverErrorBody: The server did not answer. Try reloading.
watches.signInLede: Sign in to set standing alerts on the places you care about.
watches.signInFailed: Sign-in failed — check your details and try again.
watches.sameAccount: — the same account keeps your Ask chats and alerts.
watches.geofenceHint: Fires on entering — or clearing — an escalation band around the nearest maritime boundary. No threshold to set.
watches.pfzShiftHint: Fires when a fishing-zone advisory appears in, or clears from, this position's sector. No threshold to set.
watches.simulated: SMS / IVR delivery is not built — those channels are shown as SIMULATED with the exact message that would be sent.
ask.title: Ask ORCA
chatTurn.backendErrorTitle: ORCA could not reach the backend
chatTurn.backendErrorBody: The answer service did not respond. Check that the API is running, then ask again.
chatTurn.followingOnOne: Following on from {n} earlier message in this chat
chatTurn.followingOnMany: Following on from {n} earlier messages in this chat
chatTurn.contextExpired: Earlier messages in this chat have expired, so this was answered as a new question — name your location again if it matters.
chatTurn.writtenWithoutModel: Written without a language model — no model could be reached, so these are the readings as measured.
chatTurn.llmOffTitle: Answered with every LLM provider disabled.
chatTurn.llmOffBody: The verdict, thresholds, boundary distance, citations and confidence above are all deterministic code — only the wording degrades to the plain verdict line.
intentLabel.fishingAtDefault: fishing zones in the default pilot region
personaCorrection.error: Could not re-render for that persona — the original answer is still shown.
personaCorrection.languageError: Could not switch language — the current answer is still shown.

login.signInSubtitle: Your chats, watches and alerts, on any device.
login.name: Name
profile.title: Profile
profile.lede: Home port, vessel, alerts and language — everything ORCA remembers about your account.
profile.signedOutLede: Sign in to set your home port, vessel and alert preferences.
profile.signInPrompt: Sign in to see your profile
profile.name: Name
profile.noHomePort: No home port set yet. Answers default to the pilot region until you set one.
profile.noVessels: No vessel on file yet. Add one so safety thresholds and fuel/endurance answers use your boat's real numbers.
profile.quietHoursExplain: During quiet hours, a non-urgent Sentinel alert is held and delivered once the window ends. A NO-GO-level alert always goes out immediately, at any hour.
profile.enableQuietHours: Hold non-urgent alerts during set hours
profile.quietNowActive: It is currently inside your quiet hours.
profile.quietNowInactive: It is currently outside your quiet hours.
profile.quietHoursCritical: Critical alerts (a NO-GO verdict, an active hazard) always reach you, quiet hours or not.
profile.preDawnBriefingExplain: A short conditions digest, sent 2 hours before the hour you typically depart — so the call is made on the shore, before you're already at the water.
profile.enablePreDawnBriefing: Send me a briefing before I usually depart
profile.defaultRoleHint: Which view ORCA opens to by default. You can still switch views anytime from the account menu.
